title: FLUX.2 Klein 9B Attention - Attribute Separation Test

global.positive_source: A polished cinematic science-fiction photograph of exactly two adult female explorers standing side by side, both completely visible from head to toe and facing the camera. Keep a narrow visible gap between them and use a balanced, symmetrical composition.

background.positive_source: The explorers stand inside a dark lunar research station with panoramic windows. Earth is visible in space behind them. The metallic floor has subtle reflections and cool cinematic rim lighting.

prompts.positive_source: The explorer on the left has a short silver bob haircut and pale skin. She wears a clean matte-white armored spacesuit with cyan luminous seams, cyan gloves, and cyan boots. Her suit contains no orange parts.

The explorer on the right has long dark-brown hair and warm olive skin. She wears a glossy black armored spacesuit with vivid orange panels, orange gloves, and orange boots. Her suit contains no cyan parts.
